name: Potion of Poison
description: A red draught that glitters when the vial is shaken, the very image of a healing potion.
body:
## What it does

It looks, smells and tastes like a potion of healing. Whoever drinks it takes 3d6 poison damage and must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. Poisoned, they take 3d6 poison damage again at the start of each of their turns and repeat the save at the end; each success takes a die off, and the poison ends when none are left.

features.name: Poisoned
features.text: A DC 13 Constitution save or poisoned, taking the poison damage again at the start of each turn; each later success takes a die off until none are left.
